name: MANHUNT: The Resident
description: Another player lives in your world. He punches trees, mines, crafts, eats, sleeps-less and gears up like anyone else - but the moment you type /manhunt start he knows exactly where you are and comes for you. Lose him in the Nether and he will find your portal and camp it; run to the End and he will pitch his bed beside the frame and wait.
